summary: Convert the Projects filter menu in `components/kanban/kanban-board.tsx` from an unmanaged `<details>` popup to a controlled disclosure so the board can close it on outside interaction, Escape, and board-scroll without changing the existing project-filter controls or menu layout.

checklist.step: Add explicit open-state, trigger ref, and menu container ref for the Projects disclosure in `components/kanban/kanban-board.tsx`, keeping the current trigger button and filter content wired to the same board view state.
checklist.verification_check: Clicking the Projects trigger still opens and closes the menu, and the project checkboxes continue to reflect and update the existing `view` state.

checklist.step: Register close behavior that only runs while the menu is open: detect pointer interaction outside the disclosure container, listen for `Escape`, and restore focus to the trigger when Escape closes the menu.
checklist.verification_check: With the menu open, clicking anywhere else in the header or board closes it, pressing Escape closes it and moves focus back to the Projects trigger, and clicking labels or checkboxes inside the menu does not close it.

checklist.step: Close the menu when the board viewport scrolls so the floating popover does not remain open against moved content, without affecting refresh, drag-and-drop, or panel interactions.
checklist.verification_check: Open the Projects menu, scroll the board viewport, and confirm the menu closes immediately while the rest of the board behavior remains unchanged.
